payload.name: Supplement searches for item lists across related contexts
payload.description: When a question asks for all items a person uses or prefers during an activity, run supplementary searches with related context terms and aggregate distinct items from all retrieved memories before answering.
content: If the question asks for all items (music, books, foods, etc.) tied to an activity, do not answer from one exact-match retrieval. Run at least one additional search using related context terms such as meditation, relaxation, calming, focus, or associated settings.

When returning an item list, include distinct named items found in preference and event memories even if the memory says recommended, suggested, or calming rather than directly used during the activity.
Before finalizing, check whether the combined results cover all plausible named items from the related contexts; if a related-context search is still missing, refine keywords and search again.

solves: A question asks for all items (e.g., music tracks, books, foods) a person associates with an activity. A single exact-match search can return only memories whose wording directly names that activity, while another relevant memory describes the same item through a related context such as meditation, relaxation, or calm. The skill requires supplementary searches using related activity terms and aggregation of distinct named items across preference/event memories before answering.
